title: Fetch outcome
description: What fetch returns when it cannot give the item and the agent cannot fix the request (AD-6, AD-10, AD-21). A typed result, not an error. discarded: the ask is discarded, which an ask ID unknown to this session's epoch counts as; it carries no itemId. deleted (since agent-facing-gaps): the item is one an update deleted, or one inside a deleted question or area; its ID is never reused, and the result names it in itemId and carries unchecked while the ask has no owner. Which of the two is a rule of the outcome, written as an if/then/else, since the contract compiles in strict mode and refuses a root combinator. A closed ask's items are still fetched.
